app.title: Show HN: SimCity, but with Permits
app.author: pcai
app.description: A browser-based SimCity clone that incorporates real-world municipal permitting workflows.
proposed_tests: Launch the app in a headless browser and verify the main menu renders.
Create a new city project, add a road, and check the city grid updates.
Simulate a permit request workflow and confirm approval/rejection UI flow.
Measure page load time and compare to a vanilla SimCity web clone.
